record.what_it_does: systeme.io is an all-in-one marketing platform (funnels, email/newsletters, courses, communities, e-commerce) with a public REST API for managing contacts, tags, funnels, newsletters, products, and more.
record.auth_notes: Authentication is exclusively via a static API key sent in the X-API-Key header; the docs explicitly state this is the 'only option right now' and invite feedback on adding other methods. Users can generate up to 3 API keys per account, each with an optional expiration date, from Settings > MCP & API keys.
record.access_notes: systeme.io has a permanent free plan (2,000 contacts, 3 funnels, 1 course, no credit card required) and API keys are generated directly from account settings by any user — no approval step is documented for API key issuance.
record.main_blocker: API key auth only (no OAuth2), so a multi-tenant agent toolkit must store/manage per-user static keys rather than doing an OAuth handshake

record.open_questions: Could not confirm whether a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger JSON file is publicly published (the reference docs are hosted on ReadMe.io, which is typically OpenAPI-generated, but no direct spec URL was found within the tool-call budget). Also note: the official MCP server currently supports only a subset of the full REST API's resources (no OAuth yet, key expires within 90 days, max 2 keys) — full API coverage is broader than what the MCP server currently exposes.
